criteria.name: dialog
criteria.expect: a top-level item 480x600 at pos 0 0, white, corner-radius 12

criteria.name: header
criteria.expect: a 64 high header with the 18 pt bold title Invite people

criteria.name: body
criteria.expect: the body fills the height between the header and the footer, padded 24, with the fields Email and Role

criteria.name: footer
criteria.expect: a 72 high footer at the bottom of the dialog, padded 0 24, with Cancel and Send invite at the end

criteria.name: layout
criteria.expect: layout reports no issues; the footer sits at the bottom edge of the 600 height

criteria.name: render
criteria.expect: render Empty.Empty: a dialog with a header, two fields and buttons pinned to the bottom, no warnings
